description: Defines classes and functions for translating GLSL structures and constructors into HLSL, including handling of std140 packing rules and struct definitions.

classes.name: Std140PaddingHelper
classes.description: Assists with packing std140 structs within HLSL's packing rules.

classes.name: StructureHLSL
classes.description: Handles translation of GLSL structures and constructors to HLSL, manages struct definitions and padding.

methods.name: addStructConstructor
methods.description: Returns the name of the constructor function for a given structure.

methods.name: addBuiltInConstructor
methods.description: Creates a built-in constructor for a given type and parameters.

methods.name: storeStd140ElementIndex
methods.description: Stores element index for a structure with std140 packing.

methods.name: defineQualified
methods.description: Defines a qualified struct name based on packing rules.
